The memo: -

Reference No. 1 to the prescribed procedure to be followed before payment of salary and non-salaried dues of teachers / non-teaching staff in Special Non-Government Schools / Workshops for Persons with Disabilities. Directions have been issued vide Government Circular No. 1 dated 02.01.2026, to examine and submit proposals as per the prescribed Scrutiny List.

Accordingly, as per the non-payment proposal of Priyadarshini Boys and Girls Residential Deaf School, Shirpur District Dhule run by Nalanda Education Society, Shirpur, Pune, received by the Department from the Commissioner, Divyang Kalyan, Pune, funds are being distributed to the Non-Governmental Organizations working for the persons with speech impairment (Programme), 31-Auxiliary Grants (Non-Payment) Grants as follows.
